review: [Kurokumo Clan Wakashu] Hong Lu is an identity when used alone, shines until the end of Canto 3 and then starts to fall off the more you progress through the story, which is mostly due to his low clashing power. However, when paired in a team with [Kurokumo Clan Captain] Ishmael, Hong Lu, like the rest of the standard Kurokumo IDs, gets a noticeable boost not only in terms of damage but also in terms of Bleed infliction. Kurokumo Hong Lu with buffs from [Kurokumo Clan Captain] Ishmael turns into one of the better Bleed Potency applicators in the game.
